tasks.title: Conversation #63
tasks.transcript:
Man: Lisa, you've been taking guitar lessons, right? How's that going?
Woman: It's good. I'm having fun and there are four or five songs I can play pretty well now.
Man: I've been thinking about it myself. I just finished a big work project so I've got some spare time.
Woman: If you'll wait here a minute I'll give you my teachers information. She's great.
Man: Do you do it online or in person?
Woman: I took a few lessons in person to get started. It's helpful to have someone show you some basic things, but now we do it online and it works well.

questions.stem: What is the man interested in doing?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：男生对做什么感兴趣？ 定位原文：I've been thinking about it myself. 选项分析： A. Starting a big work project 开新项目。已完成，不是目标，所以错误。 B. Learning to play guitar 学吉他。明确表达兴趣，因此正确。 C. Teaching online 教学。无关，所以错误。 D. Taking voice lessons 声乐课。无关，所以错误。

questions.stem: What will the woman likely do next?

options.B: Give the man her teacher's contact information

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：女生接下来可能会做什么？ 定位原文：I'll give you my teacher's information. 选项分析： A. Buy a new guitar 买吉他。未提及，所以错误。 B. Give the man her teacher's contact information 给老师联系方式。原文直接对应，因此正确。 C. Join a band 加入乐队。无关，所以错误。 D. Take more lessons in person 上更多线下课。未提及，所以错误。
